name: Can AKN Design Group help update an existing patio, or do you only build new ones?

mainEntity.name: Can AKN Design Group help update an existing patio, or do you only build new ones?

acceptedAnswer.text: AKN Design Group specializes in substantial, coordinated residential renovations, which includes the transformation of existing outdoor spaces. While our focus is on comprehensive projects rather than minor repairs, we can certainly evaluate an existing patio for an upgrade or expansion as part of a larger outdoor living project. This could involve integrating new features like an outdoor kitchen, adding a covered structure, or completely redesigning the hardscaping to enhance functionality and aesthetics. We are for clients seeking customized solutions that enhance functionality, beauty, and long-term value. Our goal is to unify design and construction under one contractor for a managed process, whether starting fresh or transforming an existing space.
acceptedAnswer.description: AKN Design Group can update or expand existing patios as part of larger outdoor living projects, focusing on comprehensive transformations rather than minor repairs, to enhance functionality and aesthetics.
